g.title: Visible wiring notes
g.text: Do not connect lamp negatives together if individual flashing is required.
Shared +V is OK; switched low side controls each lamp.
Use INPUT_PULLUP. IRFB11N50APBF is not logic-level; replace if LEDs are dim.

g.title: Common ground rail
g.text: COMMON GROUND: ESP32 + 12V supply - + switches + MOSFET sources
